name: claude-code-coach
description: Workflow coaching for Claude Code developers — connects to your locally running Claude Code Coach desktop app to show live status, workspace, and runtime state in VS Code. Independent, community project; not affiliated with or endorsed by Anthropic.

commands.title: Claude Code Coach: Open Desktop Coach

claudeCodeCoach.autoStartService.description: Automatically start the bundled Coach service in the background when no service (standalone or desktop) is already reachable. Never runs anything if a service is already running elsewhere, and never requires Python — the bundled service is a self-contained executable. Turn off if you always run your own standalone service or the desktop app, or if you'd rather this extension never start a background process.

claudeCodeCoach.pollIntervalSeconds.description: How often the extension re-checks the local Coach service when the shared signal file hasn't changed (fallback poll, seconds).

claudeCodeCoach.coaching.notificationsEn.description: Enable coaching notifications. Master switch for native VS Code notifications from Claude Code Coach; the panel and status bar are unaffected by this setting.

enumDescriptions: High only — notify only for high-confidence, actionable signals (e.g. broad exploration for a narrow task).
High + Medium — also notify for medium-confidence coaching signals (e.g. context becoming noisy).
Off — never show a native notification, even for high-confidence signals. The panel and status bar still update.
claudeCodeCoach.coaching.notificationLev.description: Which coaching signal levels may trigger a native notification. Positive/low-level signals never trigger a native notification, regardless of this setting.
